predictor.notes: Best-supported predictor for integer quantities 1..1000: total price is quantity times 3198 pence for 1..163, 1865 pence for 164..505, and 980 pence for 506..1000. All 96 successful business responses, covering 93 distinct quantities, match exactly; every response reported roundingCents=0. Approved results at 50 and 200 also agree. Both transitions were checked at adjacent integers: 163/164 and 505/506. Broad and off-grid validation found no departures from these three linear bands; the maximum gap between sampled quantities is 16. Used 11 REA operations including inspection. Predictions for unobserved quantities remain inferred: narrow additional bands or isolated exceptions between samples cannot be ruled out.
